p.i: Illic exhausti posuere cubilia venti,Tænarus mons. Fulminibúsque iter est:medium caua nubila montis Insumpsere latus, summos nec prapetis ala Plausus addit colles,nec rauca tonitrua pulsant.

Ast vbi prona dies longos super aquora fines Exigit,atque ingens medio natat vmbra profundo, Interiore sinu frangentia littora curuat Tanarus, expositos non audens scandere fluctus: Illic Ægeo Neptunus gurgite fessosPer Tænarū_ itur ad Manes & infernum. Inportum deducit equos:prior haurit habenas Vngula,postremi soluuntur in aquora pisces.

Hoc(vt fama)loco pallentes deuius vmbras Trames agit,nigrique Iouis vacua atria ditat Mortibus, Arcadij perhibent si vera coloni. Stridor ibi,& gemitus poenarum,atróque tumultu Feruet ager:sæpe Eumenidum vocésque,manúsque, Inmedium sonuere diem,latíque triformis Ianitor agricolas campis auditus abegit.
Hac & tunc fusca volucer Deus obsitus vmbra Exilit ad superos,infernáque nubila vultu Discutit,& vivis afflatibus ora serenat.
Qui tenet vndisonam Psamathen,semperque patetemValer. Flac. Argon. li. I. Psamathe insula. Tænaron Euphemus.
Quo Styx,& inuisi horrida TanariHorat. carm. lib. I. Sedes, Atlanteúsque fines Concutitur.Stat. Theb. lib. 3.
Et iam noctiuagas inter Deus armiger vmbras Desuper Arcadia fines,Nemaéque rura Tanariúmque cacumen, Apollineásque TerapnasTerapnæ op. Armorum tonitru ferit,& trepidantia corda Implet amore sui.

page.notes: Marginal notes transcribed as best legible; the note "Terapnæ op." and the scattered side notes near the bottom are partly illegible. Catchword absent. Some words in the printed verse are uncertain (e.g. "patetem", "Psamathen") and are left as printed.
